offence_note: Possession for trafficking fentanyl/heroin; possession of airgun and baton
sentence_quote: In my view, an appropriate sentence here is four years on each trafficking count to be served concurrently, less time served.
note: Weapons counts 90 and 120 days concurrent; time served 317 days credited as 475.

offence_note: Manslaughter (provocation) of man who sexually assaulted offender
sentence_quote: Taking all the circumstances into account, I am not satisfied that the sentence imposed of four years, in addition to the one year credit, is so manifestly inadequate that interference by this Court would be warranted
note: Crown appeal for longer sentence dismissed; four years imposed plus one year credit.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking marihuana and methamphetamine
sentence_quote: I am satisfied that all of the principles of sentencing can be met by a custodial disposition of two years less one day, but that that disposition can be served conditionally.
note: Curfew conditions; surcharge waived; co-accused charges stayed.

offence_note: Second degree murder by 14-year-old young person
sentence_quote: Accounting for the time spent on remand, the IRCS disposition will be six years, three years of which will be served in custody, and the remaining three years under community supervision.
note: Intensive rehabilitative custody and supervision order; 7 years reduced by 12 months for remand; 3 custody, 3 supervision.

offence_note: Possession for trafficking drugs; break and enter into pharmacy
sentence_quote: However, as discussed below, applying the fundamental principle of proportionality, that sentence is properly ordered to be served concurrently with the sentences for the other June offences and the sentence for the February and March offences.
note: Majority orders 5-year sentence concurrent not consecutive to existing sentence; dissent would affirm. Exact final sentence not shown.

offence_note: Sexual touching of a seven-year-old girl
sentence_quote: The respondent received a conditional sentence of 21 months with strict terms after his plea to a charge of touching a seven year-old girl for a sexual purpose.
note: Crown appeal dismissed; probation not mentioned, value unstated may be none.

offence_note: Production and possession of marijuana for trafficking
co_offenders: Vu: 13 months reduced to time served
sentence_quote: The appellants have served five and a half months and we would reduce the sentence to time served.
note: Racial profiling claim about search warrant rejected; 13 months reduced to time served (5.5 months).

offence_note: Three shoplifting thefts and two breaches of undertaking
sentence_quote: I would substitute a sentence of six months to be followed by a term of probation of one year.
note: One year less 4.5 months credit reduced to six months plus probation with residential treatment conditions.

offence_note: Break and enter of a dwelling house
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal and I would impose a sentence of 161 days imprisonment which I understand will result in a probable discharge date for Ms. Colin of June 30, 2005.
note: Ten month concurrent sentence replaced to match intended release date.

offence_note: Possession of stolen vehicle; three counts dangerous driving causing bodily harm
sentence_quote: This is an appeal from a sentence of 18 months imprisonment imposed on the appellant on February 28, 2006
note: Leave to appeal refused because of fraud on the court (false identity and record); global sentence 20 months 7 days.
